Assuming you haven't had the interview yet, prep questions that you want to ask them. First, you get a lot of information on whether or not you want the job. More importantly, you stand out.

  • Ask the interviewer where he/she plans to be in 5 years. A little role reversal there, but it gives you an idea of where the company is going.
